proof_body:
by
  have hs : ∀ m : ℕ, 4 ≤ m → (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, Nat.factorial (k + 1)) % 5 = 3 := by
    intro m hm
    induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => decide
    | succ m hm ih =>
      have h5 : 5 ∣ Nat.factorial (m + 1) := Nat.dvd_factorial (by norm_num) (by omega)
      have h0 : Nat.factorial (m + 1) % 5 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h5
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.add_mod, ih, h0]
  intro n hn
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    by_contra hne
    have hcases : n = 2 ∨ 4 ≤ n := by omega
    rcases hcases with rfl | h4
    · have : r * r = 3 := by
        rw [← hr]; decide
      have hr2 : r ≤ 1 ∨ 2 ≤ r := by omega
      rcases hr2 with h | h
      · interval_cases r <;> omega
      · nlinarith
    · have hmod := hs n h4
      rw [hr] at hmod
      have : r % 5 = 0 ∨ r % 5 = 1 ∨ r % 5 = 2 ∨ r % 5 = 3 ∨ r % 5 = 4 := by omega
      rcases this with h | h | h | h | h <;> simp [Nat.mul_mod, h] at hmod
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨1, by decide⟩
    · exact ⟨3, by decide⟩
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → (IsSquare (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Nat.factorial (k + 1)) ↔ n = 1 ∨ n = 3)
